name: Janome
title: Janome Sewing Machines UK: Range, History and Servicing
description: Janome sewing machines: the meaning of the name, the brand’s history since 1921, why schools and home sewers choose it, and how to get parts and servicing.
intro: Dependable domestic machines with a strong following in UK homes, schools and colleges.

image.alt: White and blue domestic sewing machine

cardText: History since 1921, the “snake’s eye” bobbin, and who Janome suits.

sections.html: The company was founded in Japan in 1921. “Janome” means “snake’s eye”, a reference to the round bobbin design that was a feature of its early machines.
Janome is known for straightforward, reliable machines. Mechanical and computerised models are common in schools and with beginners; larger models with extra throat space appeal to quilters.
Janome also makes overlockers and coverstitch machines for home sewers who want professional finishes on knits.

Janome is a Japanese company founded in 1921. Its name means “snake’s eye” in Japanese, a nod to the round bobbin system used in its early machines. Janome later acquired the American New Home brand, which is why you may see older New Home machines with very similar designs. Janome has a long-established UK operation and a network of UK dealers.

• Quilters: Janome is popular with quilters thanks to wide throat space on larger models and good straight-stitch quality. See our quilting and patchwork guide.
  • Dressmakers: mid-range computerised models offer a good balance of stitches, speed control and buttonholes.
  • Schools and classes: simple, sturdy mechanical models are common in classrooms.

Use the needle type and bobbins your manual specifies; many Janome models use a particular bobbin class, and a near-fit bobbin can cause stitch problems. Clean the bobbin area regularly and book a service if the stitch quality changes. Our servicing guide explains how often.

sections.h2: Parts and servicing for Janome machines
sections.html: Janome machines are among the makes PK Sewing Machines lists on its website. Leicester’s hosiery heritage means the city has deep machinery know-how.

faqs.q: Are Janome machines good for quilting?
faqs.a: Many quilters choose Janome, particularly larger models with extra space to the right of the needle. Check the throat space and feed options of the specific model.
